title: Boston: Historic Waters
gallery_text: This map traces Boston's reconstructed historic shoreline and maps against projected 2070 flood exposure with an additional layer of income vulnerability.
description: This map was an exercise in exploring how Boston's past geography may intersect with its climate future. The bright blue line marks historic high water (coastline) of Boston, while the blue squares represent the share of the 150 meter cell exposed to a projected/potential 2070 flood. Orange cells show the percentage of residents living below the 150% federal poverty threshold. There is not a strong relationship between these two metrics, or rather, there seems to be an inverse relationship between the two.
